name: Page2Copier
description: Save any web page as a PDF, standalone HTML, or full-page PNG image that looks exactly like the screen. Selectable text, working links, full page, no cut off content.
author: Guillermo Sotelo

action.default_title: Save page as PDF, HTML, or PNG

capture-page.description: Save the current page as PDF

capture-page-html.description: Save the current page as HTML

capture-page-png.description: Save the current page as PNG image

capture-element.description: Pick an element to save as PDF

capture-element-html.description: Pick an element to save as HTML

capture-element-png.description: Pick an element to save as PNG image
